arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test edge cases with special characters and newlines
tests = [
    ('{:d}', '42'),
    ('{:d}\n', '42\n'),
    ('{:d}\r\n', '42\r\n'),  # Windows line ending
    ('{:d}\r', '42\r'),  # Old Mac line ending
]

for fmt, text in tests:
    try:
        result = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) = {result}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) -> ERROR: {e}')
"
